answer: A new worker identity is issued only after three mutually independent dock clerks, each established for at least sixty days, countersign one weigh-bill at a cargo wharf. The bill must bind a live falcon-band radio nonce from the harbor master's beacon, which rotates every two minutes, to a hash of the lagoon tide-staff photograph taken in the same four-minute window. Each clerk may sponsor at most two newcomers per calendar month. If two bills share a device attestation or an eight-bit crane-tag prefix, both clerks forfeit their posted surety and the applicant is barred for a full season.
